**Abstract**: Fitting a body to a 3D clothed human point cloud is a common yet challenging task. Traditional optimization-based approaches often struggle with convergence issues, especially when dealing with complex human shapes and varying clothing. This paper presents **ETCH**, a novel geometry-aware generative model that learns to fit a template body to a 3D point cloud of a clothed human. ETCH is designed to handle diverse clothing and human shapes by incorporating a new type of loss function and a modified optimization strategy. The model leverages equivariant neural networks to ensure that the body fitting process is invariant to the pose of the input point cloud, which is crucial for robustness. ETCH achieves state-of-the-art performance in terms of accuracy and efficiency.
